Description

Overview:

Founded in 1988, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders and investors seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to help them scale their business and make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit. As the largest master servicer of commercial real estate loans in the United States, Trimont manages securitizations with meticulous oversight and coordination—protecting cash flows, mitigating risk, and ensuring portfolio performance.

Trivinna, a Trimont company, is redefining the future of commercial loan management through advanced technology and data-driven innovation. As the newest addition to the Trimont group, trivinna introduces a modern loan management software platform that streamlines operations, increases transparency, and provides clients and partners with actionable insights. Leveraging Trimont’s access to approximately 11% of all U.S. commercial real estate lending data, trivinna integrates market-leading analytics, robust portfolio management tools, and a high-touch customer support model. This comprehensive approach enables clients to make informed decisions, manage risk effectively, and achieve greater efficiency and performance in commercial real estate loan management.

Trivinna is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.

Learn: We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.

Grow: We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry’s most challenging and exciting endeavors.

Thrive: Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members and as an organization, can achieve together.

Where people, purpose, and progress come together every day.

Job Summary:

The Technology Analyst is an early-career role within Trimont's Technology Analyst Program designed for a recent college graduate who is eager to build experience at the intersection of technology, business operations, finance, product delivery, and commercial real estate. The analyst will support priority projects and upcoming releases, develop a strong understanding of Trimont's business and users, and help translate business needs into clear, practical solutions. Through hands-on assignments and cross-functional exposure, this role will build the analytical, technical, and professional foundation needed to contribute across a fast-paced, evolving organization.

Responsibilities:

Support technology initiatives, product releases, implementations, and strategic projects from planning through delivery.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify objectives, and translate business needs into actionable solutions.
Analyze business processes, user workflows, operational data, and customer feedback to identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Contribute to product development by evaluating user needs, supporting solution design, and recommending enhancements.
Develop financial models, business cases, dashboards, and other analytical tools to inform business decisions.
Prepare documentation, presentations, and recommendations that clearly communicate business and technical information.
Coordinate project activities, monitor milestones, track open items, and communicate risks or dependencies that may affect delivery.
Build knowledge of Trimont's commercial real estate services, technology platforms, business operations, and client needs.
Research market, financial, business, and technology topics to support projects and strategic priorities.
Manage assignments with initiative, adaptability, and accountability while collaborating effectively across teams.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university (IT, Data/Analytics, AI or related fields preferred). Graduates from Winter 2026/Spring 2027
Strong interest in technology-enabled business solutions, with a particular focus on leveraging artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to drive innovation and efficiency
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate information, identify patterns, and develop sound conclusions.
Technical aptitude and an interest in learning new systems, tools, technologies, and business processes.
Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with both business and technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, sound judgment, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.
Interest in technology, financial services, commercial real estate, or the intersection of these areas.
